items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: I know him, yeah. Well, he used to play with different fellows.

ctx.x: What about Willie Hightower? He's been, uh, you might have known him after Chicago. I know him, yeah. Well, he used to play with different fellows. He used to get that trumpet player too, before he left here, you know. The kid used to play around with different fellows, you know. Ask him, did he play ragtime?
